zin_lerendor_recruit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 1 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_lerendor_maelis }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_lerendor_maelis
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 2 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_lerendor_brannoc }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_lerendor_brannoc
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 3 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_lerendor_ostvar }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_lerendor_ostvar
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_character = 4 }
			NOT = { has_character = zin_lerendor_hesk }
		}
		recruit_character = zin_lerendor_hesk
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_what (keyword lean 1, gift 2, protect 3); zin_arg_value (number); zin_arg_target (number).
zin_lerendor_compact_each = {
	every_other_country = {
		limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_what = 1 } } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = ROOT.zin_arg_value }
			zin_leren_add_lean = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_what = 2 } } }
			navy_experience = 5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { zin_arg_what = 3 } } }
			ROOT = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = PREV }
				zin_leren_offer_protection = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_target (number).
zin_lerendor_dark_shore_tribute = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_leren_is_dark_shore = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_leren_lean > 39 } }
			ROOT = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = PREV }
				zin_leren_offer_protection = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				ROOT = {
					OR = {
						has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
						any_country = {
							zin_leren_is_dark_shore = yes
							any_enemy_country = { zin_leren_is_dark_shore = yes }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { is_coastal = yes }
				add_claim_by = ROOT
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_lerendor_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_friendship
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_friendship
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}

			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {

				modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_oaths
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 3 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_equals
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_equals
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 4 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {

			modifier = zin_lerendor_opinion_refused
